mukta-m0-p144-v3576.quick_english: The straight lattice joined with straight and curved elements is called the straight lattice.

mukta-m0-p144-v3577.quick_english: That same lattice, born from four corners, is remembered as elephant-eye.

mukta-m0-p144-v3578.quick_english: The root, also a tip bead, is worshipped between soft walls.

mukta-m0-p144-v3579.quick_english: A variegated hole lattice made with leaves is desired.

mukta-m0-p144-v3580.quick_english: The lattice called nandyāvarta should be led above the altar.

mukta-m0-p144-v3581.quick_english: Abandoning the middle of the wall foot, the lattice spreads seven staffs to the end.

mukta-m0-p144-v3582.quick_english: The curved height exceeds an eighth part by half a foot.

mukta-m0-p144-v3583.quick_english: Outside the middle of that wall, the pillar-yoga-door is equipped.

mukta-m0-p144-v3584.quick_english: The window position may be in the foot group or in the neck group.

mukta-m0-p144-v3585.quick_english: The root is declared threefold: square, round, and oblong.

mukta-m0-p144-v3586.quick_english: The creeper circle above is accompanied by cow urine.

mukta-m0-p144-v3587.quick_english: The conch stair, decreasing from root to tip, is desired.

mukta-m0-p144-v3588.quick_english: The width of the horse foot is double and quadruple.

mukta-m0-p144-v3589.quick_english: The diameter of the lying plank is stated as six angulas.

mukta-m0-p144-v3590.quick_english: The length may end by tithi multiplication, or as desired.

mukta-m0-p144-v3591.quick_english: The elephant stair and parched-rice stair are growth-named.

mukta-m0-p144-v3592.quick_english: Employ the elephant diameter from staff to three-staff end.

mukta-m0-p144-v3593.quick_english: Lead only an odd stair in clockwise order.

mukta-m0-p144-v3594.quick_english: That root may be the base, equipped with foot-slab group.

mukta-m0-p144-v3595.quick_english: The stair equipped with such characteristics is the abode of prosperity.

mukta-m0-p144-v3596.quick_english: Do not employ it outside the birth-etc five group.

mukta-m0-p144-v3597.quick_english: Beginning from five angulas, it increases by one angula at a time.

mukta-m0-p144-v3598.quick_english: Beginning from three angulas, it increases by half an angula.

mukta-m0-p144-v3599.quick_english: The three-foot middle is equal, with the solid hole in the middle.

mukta-m0-p144-v3600.quick_english: Or three six-sevenths parts, or then a veda-part, one should arrange.

mukta-m0-p171-v4251.quick_english: The sixty-three-foot arrangement in the brahma portion is set as nine and nine of two.

mukta-m0-p171-v4252.quick_english: Thus in the meter portion the letter arrangement has eternal form.

mukta-m0-p171-v4253.quick_english: Then place the subtle and following items in the middle, eight in number.

mukta-m0-p171-v4254.quick_english: From śakti to puruṣa, and these heart and following armors.

mukta-m0-p171-v4255.quick_english: World lords and gaṇeśas in the brahma portion, vidyeśvaras to Hari.

mukta-m0-p171-v4256.quick_english: Up to peace in the brahman portion, beyond peace in the middle.

mukta-m0-p171-v4257.quick_english: Place atoms on the seat and liṅga-form items.

mukta-m0-p171-v4258.quick_english: Place these mantras on the previous day in adhivāsa.

mukta-m0-p171-v4259.quick_english: Bring all pots together and place them on the altar.

mukta-m0-p171-v4260.quick_english: On the prepared ground, place as before.

mukta-m0-p171-v4261.quick_english: Utter the mantra taught by the guru, from root and following.

mukta-m0-p171-v4262.quick_english: By cause-abandonment yoga, what has gone out from brahmarandhra.

mukta-m0-p171-v4263.quick_english: The shining gem canopy illumines the digambara.

mukta-m0-p171-v4264.quick_english: The end of creation-path progression is like the moon lineage.

mukta-m0-p171-v4265.quick_english: Meditate on the shining star serpent from suṣumnā.

mukta-m0-p171-v4266.quick_english: Thus make presence everywhere by jīva-nyāsa.

mukta-m0-p171-v4267.quick_english: Bathe with water in pot-growth and liṅga-pedestal.

mukta-m0-p171-v4268.quick_english: Bathe the supreme lord with water from each pot.

mukta-m0-p171-v4269.quick_english: So long here, O deva, you are to stand in presence.

mukta-m0-p171-v4270.quick_english: On the consecration day, brahma stone installation or otherwise.

mukta-m0-p171-v4271.quick_english: Liṅga place and all as prescribed may also be performed.

mukta-m0-p171-v4272.quick_english: This common rite is for bāṇa and stone-made.

mukta-m0-p171-v4273.quick_english: The guru receives the dakṣiṇā determined by the yajamāna.

mukta-m0-p171-v4274.quick_english: From sixty niṣka, down to five niṣkas in order.

mukta-m0-p171-v4275.quick_english: Cows, land, gold, houses, vehicles, clothing, and the like.

mukta-m0-p174-v4326.quick_english: This, endowed with all marks, is all-giving.

mukta-m0-p174-v4327.quick_english: The face measure is prescribed as thirteen and a half units.

mukta-m0-p174-v4328.quick_english: From the eye-thread to the lid-end is declared equal to that.

mukta-m0-p174-v4329.quick_english: The throat is half an inch, and the ear is a portion-rise, to be known.

mukta-m0-p174-v4330.quick_english: From the heart to the navel is declared equal to that.

mukta-m0-p174-v4331.quick_english: From the genital root to the knee is twenty-seven units.

mukta-m0-p174-v4332.quick_english: Tala height is a portion, and may be body measure.

mukta-m0-p174-v4333.quick_english: From the turban to the hair-end is four units.

mukta-m0-p174-v4334.quick_english: The neck is four inches; the breast interval is stated.

mukta-m0-p174-v4335.quick_english: The name is remembered to the genital end.

mukta-m0-p174-v4336.quick_english: Knee measure may be by portion; shanks and thighs are equal.

mukta-m0-p174-v4337.quick_english: The turban is one inch; the hair-end is three inches.

mukta-m0-p174-v4338.quick_english: The throat is half an inch; the portion rise is in the throat.

mukta-m0-p174-v4339.quick_english: From the breast-end to the navel is declared equal to that.

mukta-m0-p174-v4340.quick_english: From that point to the front end is twenty-five units.

mukta-m0-p174-v4341.quick_english: Palm length may be by portion; thus it is declared.

mukta-m0-p174-v4342.quick_english: The eldest nine-tala has a twelve-unit tala.

mukta-m0-p174-v4343.quick_english: Marks are made with four portions and eight talas.

mukta-m0-p174-v4344.quick_english: Image measure should be divided into twenty-eight portions.

mukta-m0-p174-v4345.quick_english: The face is extended, held by turban, ear, knee, and foot.

mukta-m0-p174-v4346.quick_english: This is remembered as eternal for all gods.

mukta-m0-p174-v4347.quick_english: The turban is three inches; the hair-end is three inches likewise.

mukta-m0-p174-v4348.quick_english: The jaw-born portion is declared as three-fourths by half.

mukta-m0-p174-v4349.quick_english: From heart to navel to genital is twelve inches.

mukta-m0-p174-v4350.quick_english: When the shank is doubled in length, the palm height is reckoned by parts.

mukta-m0-p175-v4351.quick_english: The foremost neck should be an eighth part and becomes the neck.

mukta-m0-p175-v4352.quick_english: In the bow-shaped middle, between the brows, two parts are considered.

mukta-m0-p175-v4353.quick_english: The middle part also becomes a top share by half-part measure.

mukta-m0-p175-v4354.quick_english: The earringed pair has four parts plus one more part.

mukta-m0-p175-v4355.quick_english: Those two eared forms are low and raised outside.

mukta-m0-p175-v4356.quick_english: The eye is two parts long and one part wide in the middle.

mukta-m0-p175-v4357.quick_english: In the eye's middle, the light-pupil is five parts, half of that.

mukta-m0-p175-v4358.quick_english: The canthus is an eighth-part half in width and length.

mukta-m0-p175-v4359.quick_english: The upper eyelash spread is half a toe indeed.

mukta-m0-p175-v4360.quick_english: The beautiful eye should be sleepless for the action of all embodied beings.

mukta-m0-p175-v4361.quick_english: For the rough eye to be made, an eighth-part half excess is the opinion.

mukta-m0-p175-v4362.quick_english: The distance between the eyes is two parts, or slightly less.

mukta-m0-p175-v4363.quick_english: The edge-joined form should be made by foot measure, best twice-born.

mukta-m0-p175-v4364.quick_english: The raised form becomes like a sesame flower.

mukta-m0-p175-v4365.quick_english: Like a cup, it is joined with excess raised half a foot part.

mukta-m0-p175-v4366.quick_english: The straight and slanted third part is wide-joined by down and desired parts.

mukta-m0-p175-v4368.quick_english: The lip part is equal by four-parts length.

mukta-m0-p175-v4369.quick_english: The lower lip is two parts wide from length.

mukta-m0-p175-v4370.quick_english: The jaw-circle should be two parts, with a slightly raised bow-tip.

mukta-m0-p175-v4371.quick_english: The ear spread is an eighth part, joined with five-five parts nose.

mukta-m0-p175-v4372.quick_english: The face should be four angulas from the back hair limit of the head.

mukta-m0-p175-v4373.quick_english: The head spread between the ears at the back is an eighth part.

mukta-m0-p175-v4374.quick_english: The hair limit is not six-five parts; it is by an eighth part.

mukta-m0-p175-v4375.quick_english: The shoulder should be level with the throat; of which? root decay.

mukta-m0-p192-v4776.quick_english: After offering tattva and the rest, one then performs the purnahuti.

mukta-m0-p192-v4777.quick_english: The officiant is clad in new cloth, an upper garment, and adornment.

mukta-m0-p192-v4778.quick_english: At an auspicious moment and lagna, one should begin mantra nyasa.

mukta-m0-p192-v4779.quick_english: Having performed expiation with aghora, one should perform the full offering.

mukta-m0-p192-v4780.quick_english: After placing, sprinkle with those waters and worship with sandal, flowers, and the rest.

mukta-m0-p192-v4781.quick_english: Thus the sprinkling of halls and similar spaces is to be done, as the wise know.

mukta-m0-p192-v4782.quick_english: The rod of a temple is said to be half its width.

mukta-m0-p192-v4783.quick_english: The arrangement of a single enclosure is declared to be fivefold.

mukta-m0-p192-v4784.quick_english: Outside that part, the enclosure may be twofold or threefold.

mukta-m0-p192-v4785.quick_english: For a two-enclosure plan, fivefold or sixfold is desired.

mukta-m0-p192-v4786.quick_english: The rod here is said to be in the fourth part of the temple.

mukta-m0-p192-v4787.quick_english: The measures use four, five, and six parts, and likewise five, six, and seven parts.

mukta-m0-p192-v4788.quick_english: Listen, twice-born: the veda enclosure is declared fivefold.

mukta-m0-p192-v4789.quick_english: Ending in the ninth part, one should increase it all around.

mukta-m0-p192-v4790.quick_english: Thus even for a temple with four enclosures, the spacious measure applies.

mukta-m0-p192-v4791.quick_english: The wise should join half the rod by hand measure, as is said.

mukta-m0-p192-v4792.quick_english: In these, the enclosure measure for small temples is opined to be eightfold.

mukta-m0-p192-v4793.quick_english: The measures are four or five hands, and indeed five or six hands.

mukta-m0-p192-v4794.quick_english: Nanda length eightfold is indeed the measure for two enclosures.

mukta-m0-p192-v4795.quick_english: The three-enclosure measure is thus the veda enclosure one.

mukta-m0-p192-v4796.quick_english: The four-enclosure measure is declared for small temples and the rest.

mukta-m0-p192-v4797.quick_english: No universal rule exists for temples everywhere.

mukta-m0-p192-v4798.quick_english: Half, third, fourth, and double parts are used in order.

mukta-m0-p192-v4799.quick_english: The temple's spacious measure is with quarter and even proportions.

mukta-m0-p192-v4800.quick_english: Even when measuring by the hand, one should construct the temple according to the previously stated method, together with those proportions.

mukta-m0-p197-v4901.quick_english: The stairway, whether united or separated, is spoken of.

mukta-m0-p197-v4902.quick_english: One should arrange the great seat, banner, and related items in the west.

mukta-m0-p197-v4903.quick_english: For a four-gated structure, the gate may be direct or with a spear.

mukta-m0-p197-v4904.quick_english: The street may be in the east region, in the west, or in all four directions.

mukta-m0-p197-v4905.quick_english: The sleeping place is desired in the northwest and the well in the northeast.

mukta-m0-p197-v4906.quick_english: The wealth place may be between Indra and fire.

mukta-m0-p197-v4907.quick_english: The fire pit should be there, in the middle of Yama and fire.

mukta-m0-p197-v4908.quick_english: The place for Kāmika and related Śiva knowledge is situated in the south.

mukta-m0-p197-v4909.quick_english: One should arrange the flower place in Nirṛti.

mukta-m0-p197-v4910.quick_english: One should arrange the knowledge treasury in the northwest or south.

mukta-m0-p197-v4911.quick_english: The well place may be with Kubera or to the east in the Vaiśa region.

mukta-m0-p197-v4912.quick_english: One should arrange the sleeping place in the northeast.

mukta-m0-p197-v4913.quick_english: The bathing pavilion includes a well, sleeping place, and flower.

mukta-m0-p197-v4914.quick_english: The place for divine implements is not spoken, out of fear of excessive detail.

mukta-m0-p197-v4915.quick_english: There is a house for priests and an establishment for attendants.

mukta-m0-p197-v4916.quick_english: The audience pavilion may be led in all regions in various forms.

mukta-m0-p197-v4917.quick_english: Beginning from three hasts, the measurement increases by one hand's measure.

mukta-m0-p197-v4918.quick_english: Within that space is an altar equipped with sixteen pillars.

mukta-m0-p197-v4919.quick_english: Either a pit or altar-ground is used according to the specified number.

mukta-m0-p197-v4920.quick_english: For the mothers, either nine pits or one pit may be used.

mukta-m0-p197-v4921.quick_english: The pits are purified with five cow products and the like, then immersed in water.

mukta-m0-p197-v4922.quick_english: The consecration includes sleeping ascent and pot arrangement.

mukta-m0-p197-v4923.quick_english: Śiva brāhmaṇas should worship properly in the appropriate place.

mukta-m0-p197-v4924.quick_english: Palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa are used in the eastern and other directions.

mukta-m0-p197-v4925.quick_english: Then at dawn one should worship the image and the rest, the pots, and the fires.

mukta-m0-p198-v4926.quick_english: Offerings from one to ten niṣkas go to the guru and others as before.

mukta-m0-p198-v4927.quick_english: Taking the seed from the pot, one places it in its own place.

mukta-m0-p198-v4928.quick_english: The pādukā is placed outside, measured equally, with a quarter, or with a half.

mukta-m0-p198-v4929.quick_english: One causes consecration, releasing the gem deposit clockwise.

mukta-m0-p198-v4930.quick_english: Now the procedure for consecrating the great pīṭha is stated.

mukta-m0-p198-v4931.quick_english: By veda number one chooses either a kuṇḍa or a veda-cornered sthaṇḍila.

mukta-m0-p198-v4932.quick_english: On the sthaṇḍila or altar, one causes the kuṇḍa deposit.

mukta-m0-p198-v4933.quick_english: Without obstacle, thus fragrance, joy, and the chief quality are invoked.

mukta-m0-p198-v4934.quick_english: Without obstacle, the āmoda is coral-like and dark-colored.

mukta-m0-p198-v4935.quick_english: Having meditated thus, the guru worships durmukha and the kuṅkuma-colored form.

mukta-m0-p198-v4936.quick_english: From thigh to lotus end, one deposits ātmatattva and the rest.

mukta-m0-p198-v4937.quick_english: The wise one offers palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa in order.

mukta-m0-p198-v4938.quick_english: Having worshipped the pīṭha and pots, one also tends the fire at dawn.

mukta-m0-p198-v4939.quick_english: Without obstacle, one deposits the pot-middle in the karṇikā's middle.

mukta-m0-p198-v4940.quick_english: Respectfully, one bathes the pīṭha with water from that pot.

mukta-m0-p198-v4941.quick_english: But in the middle of the middle pot, the blue-red item is placed.

mukta-m0-p198-v4942.quick_english: One deposits kṣetrapāla in the west and viśvagaṇas in the soma direction.

mukta-m0-p198-v4943.quick_english: Gaṇas are placed in the west direction and yakṣas in the north direction.

mukta-m0-p198-v4944.quick_english: One deposits rākṣasas in the pitṛ region and nāga gaṇas in the vāyu direction.

mukta-m0-p198-v4945.quick_english: The teacher worships with sandal, flowers, and so on up to naivedya.

mukta-m0-p198-v4946.quick_english: One deposits five gaṇas in the karṇikā and eight in the petals.

mukta-m0-p198-v4947.quick_english: This special mantra deposit is for the piśāca bali pīṭha.

mukta-m0-p198-v4948.quick_english: First comes a vasu-varṇa mantra joined with praṇava and accompanied by Viṣṇu.

mukta-m0-p198-v4949.quick_english: The mantra accompanied by namaskāra is used in parivāra worship.

mukta-m0-p198-v4950.quick_english: Or, one may worship all the other deities together at one time.

mukta-m0-p199-v4951.quick_english: Their worship, with namah-ending and svaha-ending, is an oblation.

mukta-m0-p199-v4952.quick_english: One should especially give the oblation from the door to the end of the seat.

mukta-m0-p199-v4953.quick_english: The measure is that of a hen's egg, then half of that, then half of that.

mukta-m0-p199-v4954.quick_english: In the four-doored assembly, to Bhṛṅgi and to Vināyaka.

mukta-m0-p199-v4955.quick_english: Then one should give the afterward cow-oblation to the goddess, Caṇḍa, and Soma.

mukta-m0-p199-v4956.quick_english: Having given water, again sandal, flower, incense, and lamp.

mukta-m0-p199-v4957.quick_english: Standing on the right side of the deity, therefore one should go clockwise.

mukta-m0-p199-v4958.quick_english: In the karṇikā, for Avighna, in āmoda, on the east petal.

mukta-m0-p199-v4959.quick_english: In south, then north, and the rest, one should give oblation by their own names.

mukta-m0-p199-v4960.quick_english: Or one may give the oblation in one place, for paiśāca or for bhautika.

mukta-m0-p199-v4961.quick_english: In east, south, and inauspicious directions, one should cast oblation to stars and the like.

mukta-m0-p199-v4962.quick_english: From houses and in the northeast, to asuras, in the fire-range.

mukta-m0-p199-v4963.quick_english: Outside the petal, one should give oblation to the direction-guardians by their own names.

mukta-m0-p199-v4964.quick_english: First, one should arrange the bull in the east of the inner door.

mukta-m0-p199-v4965.quick_english: On each seat, especially in the west, is the bull position.

mukta-m0-p199-v4966.quick_english: Having abandoned the fourfold, or api, one should place the bull in front of that.

mukta-m0-p199-v4967.quick_english: Half of that is the lowest to be known, or four-three-two-fold.

mukta-m0-p199-v4968.quick_english: Having made the embryo, nine parts, ninefold, in stone-born material is the opinion.

mukta-m0-p199-v4969.quick_english: The fourfold-end measure in the clay bull is the opinion.

mukta-m0-p199-v4970.quick_english: On the seat-front, clay is declared, or stone is approved there.

mukta-m0-p199-v4971.quick_english: The stone, lime-made, should be made, lying, especially.

mukta-m0-p199-v4972.quick_english: Then, in front of the common liṅga, the bull is the opinion.

mukta-m0-p199-v4973.quick_english: Marked by direction-guardians, accomplished, the hundred-thousand-liṅga.

mukta-m0-p199-v4974.quick_english: Other than that, the bull is declared; there too it is also said, or.

mukta-m0-p199-v4975.quick_english: The liṅga is joined with iron of one-third part, has the meaning of a hanging thread, and is joined with sight.

mukta-m0-p203-v5051.quick_english: Beginning from the nanda hand, the gateway expansion increases by double double hand.

mukta-m0-p203-v5052.quick_english: From three five fifteen seven, the measure increases by one hand.

mukta-m0-p203-v5053.quick_english: Otherwise, expansion is arranged by hand measure.

mukta-m0-p203-v5054.quick_english: In the first enclosure, door-beauty expansion is desired.

mukta-m0-p203-v5055.quick_english: From twenty-five hands, the range ends at thirty-three hands.

mukta-m0-p203-v5056.quick_english: Beginning at twenty-five, the range ends at forty-three.
